class.name: IfcFlowSegmentType
class.brief_description: The element type IfcFlowSegmentType defines a list of commonly shared property set definitions of a flow segment and an optional set of product representations. It is used to define a flow segment specification (i.e. the specific product information, that is common to all occurrences of that product type).
